name: Tightbeam Decisions
author: Mike
description: Open Tightbeam decision requests with keyboard ruling.

barWidget.description: Shows open Tightbeam decision requests and lets you answer by number.

schema.label: Tightbeam host
schema.description: Blank when this machine is itself a Tightbeam node. Otherwise an ssh destination: a hostname, user@host, or an alias from ~/.ssh/config. Key-based auth is required.

schema.label: Tightbeam user
schema.description: Blank uses the account the CLI runs as.
